questions.question: [S5]: THE_EPSTEIN_CONTROL_OBJECT §5, "The located zero", printed in full above (1505 words, 77 line cites). It quotes SP4.lean :32-:33 and :36-:37 with their axiom line (b742 bank :61-:62), the three conditions (b743_ferry :11), the box (Box.lean :21-:24), the route (1)-(6) by act, the abandoned Lipschitz routes (b742_s6_plan :16-:23), the cost, and Voronin's theorem as Lee states it (b751_literature.txt). In six places the draft follows the tree and the banks over the ruling's words (b751_section5.txt D1-D6). D1: the certified enclosure of the real part, 0.85326 to 1.05326 (Box.lean :21-:22, :39-:40), contains Re s = 1, so the draft says the zero is an instance of Voronin's theorem numerically (b326_zeros_run.txt :77) and that the certificate does not decide it. D2, D3: the nodes are 20, not 16, on a circle about 1/2 + 16.290216 i, not about the centre (b742_s6_plan :28-:30). D4: S5a-S5b are b738's. D5: the Lipschitz routes were stopped before any Lean. D6: no bank carries "uniform bounds do not integrate"; the draft writes it as the paper's own sentence. If §5 passes, it goes under :170 as one PLACE-papers write, then one dated note after :9. Does [S5] pass?
